headline: Home Builders Increase Price Cuts and Mortgage Incentives Amid Weak Demand
summary: Nearly half of U.S. home builders are reducing prices and offering mortgage rate buy-downs to attract buyers, despite rising construction costs that are pressuring profit margins.
why: The housing market is highly sensitive to interest rates. When demand cools, builders often use price concessions to maintain sales volume, which can impact sector-wide profitability.

impacts.name: Home Construction
impacts.why: Rising costs combined with price cuts indicate margin compression for the sector.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
